title: Connections
description: Connect your own Telegram bots, bank feeds and Zalo OA. Then choose, in each agent's Settings, which connections that agent uses.
forbiddenTitle: Only owners and managers can manage connections
forbiddenBody: Ask an owner or manager to add or change a connection.
telegramBlurb: Customers message your own bot; the Chatbot agent answers them.
sepayBlurb: Incoming transfers to your bank account reach the Accounting agent for payment matching. This is your own account, not NIVO billing.
zaloBlurb: Customers message your shop's Zalo Official Account; the Chatbot agent answers them.
automationsLink: Automatic emails and reports are switched on in Automations
fieldNameHint: A label only you see, for example Support bot or Main account.
tgStepsTitle: How to get a bot token (about 2 minutes)
tgStep1: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather (the official blue-tick account).
tgStep2: Send the message /newbot, then type a name and a username for your shop's bot (the username must end in bot).
tgStep3: BotFather replies with a long token such as 123456:ABC-DEF... Copy the whole token.
tgStep4: Paste it below and press Connect. Keep the token private: anyone with it controls your bot.
sepayStep1: Fill in your bank account below and press Connect. NIVO creates a URL and an API key for this account.
sepayStep2: In SePay, open Integrations, Webhooks, add a webhook, and paste the URL and the API key (authentication type: API Key).
sepayStep3: Come back to Agent settings of Accounting and tick this connection for the agent.
fieldBankHint: For example VCB, MB, ACB, TCB.
keyOnceNote: Paste both into SePay now. You can show them again later from this page.
zaloSoon: Zalo only lets the shop answer within 48 hours of the customer's last message. A late reply is shown as not delivered in the workbench.
zaloCheckOk: The Zalo OA tokens are valid.
noAgentHint: No agent is bound to this connection, so its messages are not answered. Use the Agents button on this row (or the agent's Settings).
noAgentHintBank: No Accounting agent is bound to this connection, so incoming transfers are ignored. Use the Agents button on this row (or the Accounting Settings).
checkOk: Telegram has this connection's webhook registered. Waiting updates: {pending}.
checkNotRegistered: Telegram does not have this connection's webhook yet. Press Disconnect and connect again, or check the site address.
checkLocal: This is a local site: the webhook is registered only on your public domain. The bot token itself works.
checkNothing: Nothing to check for this connection type.
localNote: Local site: the connection is saved, but Telegram can only reach you once the app runs on its public domain. The webhook is registered there.
purpose_lead_source: Receives the leads of your lead ads
agentCardHint: Each connection this agent can work through, with how far it may go. The same setting as the Agents button on the Connections page.
agentCardNone: No connection of a suitable type yet.
agentCardReadOnly: Only an owner or manager can change this.
agentCardOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner changes an agent's access.
agentCardNoneForModule: This agent does not use connections.
errName: Give the connection a name (at least 2 characters).
errFormat: That does not look like a Telegram bot token. It looks like 123456789:AAE... - copy it again from @BotFather.
errToken: Telegram rejected this token. Check that you copied the whole token from @BotFather, or create a new one with /token.
errNetwork: Could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errInUse: This bot is already connected to a workspace. Disconnect it there first, or create another bot with @BotFather.
errWebhook: The bot token is valid, but Telegram refused the webhook address.
errAccount: The account number must be 6 to 20 digits.
errApiKey: The API key must be 16 to 128 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
errBankFields: Enter the bank code and the account holder.
errZaloFields: Enter the App ID (digits only) and the app's secret key.
errZaloToken: Zalo did not accept the saved tokens. Press Reconnect to authorize the Official Account again.
errKeys: Paste every key exactly as the provider shows it.
errPayosConfirm: payOS did not accept the webhook address. Check the Client ID and API Key, then save the keys again.
accessReadOnly: Agents: {summary}. Only the workspace owner changes this.
accessUnusable: Cannot use this kind of connection
accessHint_read: Sees what comes in, never sends through it
accessHint_ask: Everything it would send waits for your approval
accessHint_auto: Acts on its own within the Authority rules
ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can add, change or remove connections.
errAccessPair: {agent} cannot use {connection}: that kind of connection is not for this agent.
errAccessDisconnected: {connection} is disconnected. Reconnect it before giving an agent access.
libEmptyHint: Try another word or clear the filters. Tell us what you need with Want it on a planned connector.
detailWanted: Noted. We build the most wanted connectors first.
detailSoon: This connector is planned. Press Want it and we will build the most wanted ones first.
connectedEmptyHint: Open the Library to connect a payment feed, a chat channel or a data source.
attentionPending: Setup is not finished. Continue where you left off.
attentionError: This connection stopped working. Open it to fix it.
attentionMore: {count} more connections also need attention below.
disconnectBody: Agents using it stop receiving its messages or payments. You can connect it again later.
removeBody: The connection and its saved keys are deleted. This cannot be undone.
emptyAllBody: Start with the bank feed, so the Accounting agent sees money arriving.
provider_openapi_blurb: Paste a Swagger link: NIVO pulls data from the endpoints you pick, and agents may call the ones you allow.
provider_database_blurb: PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server, read only: pick the customer, order and product tables NIVO syncs.
provider_csv_import_blurb: Upload an Excel or CSV list of customers, orders or products; map the columns once, upload again to update.
provider_imap_blurb: Reads incoming mail of the mailbox you choose (read only) so agents see requests, orders and invoices sent by email.
provider_telegram_user_blurb: Reads the chats you pick on a personal Telegram account. Read only, disconnect any time.
provider_sepay_blurb: Money arriving in your bank account reaches the Accounting agent for matching.
guide_sepay_basic_4_label: Tự động gửi lại khi server trả lỗi
guide_sepay_security_2_text: Leave the remaining steps as they are, then press Save.
verify_sepay_test_intro: Money in test mode is not real.
verify_sepay_test_0: On SePay, turn on the Test Mode switch at the top right.
verify_sepay_test_1: Open Transactions and press Simulate transaction.
verify_sepay_test_2: Pick the account {bank} · {account}, enter 2,000 and create the transaction.
verify_sepay_live_intro: A small real transfer is the surest way to know it works.
verify_sepay_live_0: Transfer a small amount, for example 2,000 VND, into the account {bank} · {account} from another bank or wallet.
provider_payos_blurb: Orders paid through payOS reach the Accounting agent for matching.
provider_payos_noTest: NIVO knows of no separate test mode in payOS, so only Live is available. Try it with a small amount.
guide_payos_channel_2_text: Name it and pick the bank account that receives your money on payOS, then create the channel.
guide_payos_webhook_1_text: NIVO asks payOS to confirm this address when you press Save keys. If the channel has a Webhook URL box you can paste it there too.
verify_payos_live_intro: A small real order is the surest way to know it works.
verify_payos_live_0: Create a small payment link, for example 2,000 VND, on payOS.
verify_payos_live_1: Pay that link with your banking app.
provider_casso_blurb: Money arriving in your bank account is relayed by Casso to the Accounting agent for matching.
provider_casso_noTest: NIVO knows of no separate test mode in Casso, so only Live is available. Try it with a small transfer.
guide_casso_setup_1_hint: Casso generates this key. Copy it from Casso and paste it here.
guide_casso_setup_2_text: Press Save on Casso to finish the integration.
verify_casso_live_intro: A small real transfer is the surest way to know it works.
verify_casso_live_0: Transfer a small amount, for example 2,000 VND, into the account {bank} · {account} from another bank or wallet.
provider_telegram_blurb: Customers message your own bot; the Chatbot agent answers them.
guide_telegram_botfather_0_text: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather (the official account with the blue tick).
guide_telegram_botfather_2_text: Give your shop's bot a name and a username (the username must end in bot).
guide_telegram_botfather_3_text: BotFather replies with a long token like 123456:ABC-DEF... Copy all of it.
provider_zalo_oa_blurb: Customers message your shop's Zalo Official Account; the Chatbot agent answers them.
guide_zalo_oa_app_0_text: Open developers.zalo.me, sign in with the Zalo account that administers your shop's OA, and create a new app.
guide_zalo_oa_app_2_text: Copy the App ID and the app's secret key (App Secret) from the general settings and paste them into NIVO.
guide_zalo_oa_link_1_text: Link your shop's Official Account to this app (your account must be an administrator of the OA).
guide_zalo_oa_link_3_text: Under Permissions, request message management, follower information and consultation messages.
guide_zalo_oa_webhook_1_label: Sự kiện: Người dùng gửi tin nhắn văn bản (user_send_text)
guide_zalo_oa_webhook_3_hint: Zalo shows this key on the Webhook page. NIVO uses it to check that every message Zalo sends is genuine.
provider_meta_blurb: Customers message or comment on your Facebook Page and Instagram account; agents answer, and lead-ad leads land straight in NIVO.
provider_webhook_blurb: NIVO sends events (new customer, order, payment...) to n8n, Make, Zapier or any address you choose.
guide_webhook_n8n_0_text: In n8n add a Webhook node: Method POST, then copy the Production URL.
provider_google_blurb: Connect your Google account so NIVO can record orders in your spreadsheet.
provider_smtp_blurb: Send reports, receipts and payment reminders from your own shop email.
